primary_reader_tasks: understand the event sequence and duration

observed_symptoms: content clustered toward the upper page
iteration_history.learning: Content correctness does not establish visual identity or reader navigation.

observed_symptoms: metadata and list groups still looked templated
iteration_history.learning: Color changes alone do not solve layout composition.

observed_symptoms: repeated boxed or card-like groups remained
iteration_history.learning: Repeated rectangles can create a rigid visual grammar even when the palette is coherent.

observed_symptoms: open editorial lists improved the page
manual pagination created a blank page
iteration_history.learning: Every layout change must be rendered again and checked for page-flow regressions.

observed_symptoms: composition still appeared flat and mechanically repetitive
iteration_history.learning: A technical layout fix does not establish visual acceptance.

observed_symptoms: motif family repeated across cover, materials and timeline
metadata and narrative lists no longer enclosed as cards
schedule expressed as a curved sequence
iteration_history.learning: Motif continuity, varied rhythm and purposeful negative space can add character without inventing content.

open_design_risks: Final motif preference is not yet confirmed by the user.
Reader-task usability has not been tested with representative readers.
The composition must be adapted to other document families rather than reused as a universal template.

reusable_controls: Separate content integrity, layout integrity, visual composition and reader usability gates.
Do not encode a universal attention-span duration.
Choose visual hierarchy around actual reader tasks.
Avoid repeated cards or rectangular frames when open typography, columns or timelines communicate the content more clearly.
Use a motif family with semantic or identity relevance; do not paste unrelated decoration onto a template.
Assess whitespace by function and page-to-page rhythm, not by a universal fill percentage.
Render and inspect every page after meaningful revisions.
Keep eye-tracking status NOT_MEASURED unless eye-tracking evidence exists.
limitations: This is one sanitized event-TOR iteration case and is not representative of every institution, discipline or document family.
The public learning record contains no original TOR text, identity values, source files, filenames or hashes.
Visual composition proxy results are not a measure of gaze, comprehension or aesthetic preference.
